newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom said to start controversial discounts.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom said to start controversial discounts.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom will go ahead and introduce 35 percent discounts for big customers even though competitors have protested to the European Commission over the move, the Handelsblatt daily said on Wednesday.
Quoting a Telekom spokesman, Handelsblatt said that the company had won the approval of Post and Telecommunications Minister Wolfgang Boetsch for the discounts.

A group of six competitors had complained to EU competition commissioner Karel Van Miert over the price cuts, which are due to be introduced on November 1. Van Miert has not yet commented on the protest.
State-owned Telekom is in the midst of its initial public offering, Europe's largest ever privatisation, and its shares will start trading on November 18.
